model: Sequential MCMC pilot v1 · partial 2026 preview
priorApproximation: Joint Gaussian moment match on active preseason driver and previous-team strengths; mean-only small within-season age delta
limitations: Only the first four rounds are available in this completed pilot; later rounds are pending, not filled with old simulations.
Each forecast uses earlier race orders only, but its participant set is retrospectively conditioned on actual eligible finishers. Not a full-grid pre-race forecast.
Driver baseline, season form and team strength are inferred jointly; this is not isolated driving quality.
This early pilot uses a Gaussian approximation to the historical prior and mean within-season age adjustment. The continuing full-season model propagates age uncertainty explicitly.
Reset/form/process settings are research choices. Related eight-round historical checks are encouraging, not full validation of this exact preview.
Model-derived ranges and descriptive tail frequencies are not calibrated confidence guarantees or p-values.
